name: xml-editor
description: XML formatting, schema (XSD) driven IntelliSense, hover documentation, and validation for .xml and .xsd files.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces, schemas are never downloaded and workspace-level schema associations are ignored.

xmlEditor.fileExtensions.markdownDescription: File extensions the XML editor provides completion, hover, validation, and formatting for. Add others such as `.config` or `.xaml` here; files outside VS Code's built-in XML language also need a `files.associations` entry mapping them to `xml`.

xmlEditor.schemas.markdownDescription: Associates XML Schema (XSD) files with documents. Each entry needs a `url` and at least one of `fileMatch` or `namespace`. Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder of the document.

url.markdownDescription: Location of the schema: a path relative to the workspace folder, an absolute path, `${workspaceFolder}/...`, `~/...`, or an `http(s)://` URL.

fileMatch.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of documents the schema applies to, relative to the workspace folder (for example `**/*.config.xml` or `config/app.xml`). A pattern without `/` matches the file name in any folder.

namespace.markdownDescription: A namespace URI. Any document that declares this namespace (for example with `xmlns="..."`) uses the schema, wherever the file lives.

xmlEditor.validation.enabled.description: Report well-formedness, namespace, and schema errors.

xmlEditor.schemaLocation.enabled.markdownDescription: Use `xsi:schemaLocation` and `xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation` hints in documents to find schemas.

xmlEditor.schemaDownload.enabled.markdownDescription: Allow schemas at `http://` and `https://` locations to be downloaded. Never applies in untrusted workspaces.

xmlEditor.completion.autoCloseTags.markdownDescription: Insert `</name>` after typing `>` at the end of a start tag, and complete the element name after typing `</`.

xmlEditor.format.splitAttributes.description: Put each attribute on its own line when an element has more than one attribute.

xmlEditor.format.selfCloseEmptyElements.markdownDescription: Rewrite empty elements such as `` as ``.

xmlEditor.format.spaceBeforeSelfClose.markdownDescription: Write self-closing tags as `<a />` rather than `<a/>`.

xmlEditor.format.preserveBlankLines.description: Keep a single blank line where the document had one or more blank lines between elements.
